extracted.name: Savory Turkey Gravy
extracted.description: This gravy for your Thanksgiving turkey is easy to make with turkey stock, poultry seasoning, celery salt, and black pepper.
instruction_lines: Bring turkey stock to a boil in a medium saucepan.
Whisk water and flour together in a small bowl until smooth; gradually whisk into turkey stock. Season with poultry seasoning, salt, pepper, and celery salt.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer until thickened, 8 to 10 minutes.
